objective: Create the first current-session formal U45 per-member decision/ranking and source-bound strategy buy zones after Run053 macro-cap, Run054 risk evidence and Run055 strategy-zone contract acceptance. Preserve raw provider material privately; public output is structured metadata/decisions only.

decision_contract.score_semantics: 0-100 cross-sectional U strategy-priority score under one frozen rubric; not a probability, return forecast, or position size
decision_contract.rank_semantics: Deterministic descending score rank among model-valid eligible U members; macro cap must not change score/rank
decision_contract.formal_buy_rule: BUY is accepted only when model_decision is BUY_CANDIDATE and a source-bound numeric strategy zone resolves from allowed verified anchors without schema/risk-contract violation
decision_contract.top3_rule: Top3 contains only accepted formal BUY rows, ordered by rank. Fewer than three is valid and means keep remaining capacity in cash.
decision_contract.top10_rule: Top10 is the ten highest-ranked model-valid eligible rows for observation; inclusion does not imply BUY.
decision_contract.macro_rule: Run053 30% account ceiling attaches after ranking and cannot alter model score/rank or manufacture a BUY.
decision_contract.execution_rule: No firm quote, Entry-v1 intersection, order, fill, fee/FX sizing, or simulated journal write occurs in Run056.
decision_contract.missingness_rule: Company/sector/capital/news missingness stays explicit. Model may return WATCH or BLOCKED_DATA; absence of verified bad news is never treated as evidence of safety.
decision_contract.legacy_rule: Run004 pilot weights/ranking and Run044 OBSERVE labels are not promoted as current formal rankings or BUY decisions.

provider_plan.private_raw_destination: Google Drive primary via existing DSA Drive runner credentials

definition_of_done: Two bounded provider batches cover all 44 eligible U members exactly once; raw requests/responses are privately persisted and hash-restorable; structured outputs pass schema/fact/anchor validation; one deterministic global ranking is created; numeric strategy zones exist only for validated BUY_CANDIDATE rows; Top3 contains only accepted BUY rows and may contain fewer than three; macro cap is attached separately; no order/fill/simulation write is created.
